verdict.rationale: Lago ships automation-like features, including an AI billing agent, a Dunning Agent and webhooks, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of versioning, change review or rollback for any of these. The API versioning doc covers API compatibility, not automation history, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
